newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 249 OF OCTOBER 1, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 249 OF OCTOBER 1, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
